title: Altar S2 Arc1
description: A Paper 1.21+ plugin that adds custom altars, mythic weapons, abilities, recipes, custom items, and progression systems.
body:
![Altar Recreation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/30cf02a3f4df46bd5d71791cf1861189a915e4ed.jpeg)
**PLEASE NOTE THAT THIS IS A RECREATION NOT EVERYTHING WILL BE 1:1.**
**PLEASE NOTE THIS WONT WORK WITHOUT THE PACKET EVENT PLUGIN.**
# Commands
- /altars2:legendaries
- /recipes
- /altars2:arc
- /altars2:session
- /altars2:setkills
- /altars2:altar <weapon>
- /altars2:cooldown
- /altars2:altars2 items 
- /altars2:trust
- /altars2:altars2 reload
- /altars2:<weapon>
